column3: NASB has “Magor-missabib” left as a name; “Terror on every side” is its meaning.
“Men of my peace” is rendered “trusted friends.”
“Kidneys” is rendered “mind”; NASB uses the archaic “seest.”
“A son, a male” is rendered “A baby boy.”
“He did not kill me from the womb” is rendered “before birth.”
